scoring_justification: Checker verifies agent-reported band gap and adsorption energy values against digitized paper references with tolerances, plus structural trends; full recompute from raw DFT outputs is not feasible in verifier sandbox.

outputs.description: Band gap energies for the pristine and all nine doped CNT(6,0) variants. The hidden checker compares the submitted values to the paper's reported band gaps (reference) within a tolerance and enforces structural trends.

Adsorption energies of Cu, Ag, Au on CNT(6,0) at the three sites. The hidden checker compares the submitted values to the paper's reported adsorption energies (reference) within a tolerance and enforces site/metal ordering.

output_contract.notes: NBO analysis (step 5) is required as a process step but is not scored because the paper shows only qualitative color-mapped charges without explicit numeric targets. The scored outputs are band_gaps.csv and adsorption_energies.csv; both must be present and match the declared schema.

steps.description: Fraction of Eg values within 0.05 eV of paper reference values.
Enforces three trend groups: (1) all doped Eg > pristine; (2) per site, Cu<Ag<Au; (3) Cu min Outside, Ag and Au min Inside.
Fraction of Eads values within 0.1 eV of paper reference values.
Enforces that for each metal (Cu, Ag, Au), Eads(I) > Eads(E) > Eads(O) (more negative as adsorption site moves outward).

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for band gap and adsorption energy comparison
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Digitized from Figure 5 and Table 2 of the paper; values reproduced in the reference solve.sh output.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values taken directly from solve.sh, which writes the paper-reported numbers (band gap from Figure 5, adsorption energies from Table 2 in eV).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact numbers the reference solve.sh outputs; they are the paper-reported target values, traceable to the paper's quantitative claims, used to verify that an agent reproduces the published results.
